notes.title: AMD/ATI compatibility improved
notes.notes: Update for addressing recent AMD/ATI 3D cards drivers issues

notes.title: Update v6.84 for Power & Revolution 2022 Edition
notes.notes:
See below the list of main corrections and improvments:

-Correction on the save reload from a mod of a game before patch 6.83
-Display of the correct head of the Irish Prime Minister
-Corrections on AI-triggered conflict creations between allied countries following city battles
-Repositioned the port of Hamburg
-Fixed a crash related to the number of stations served by Hyperloop trains
-Adaptation of the AI decisions to build renewable energy plants according to the available surfaces on the territory
-Unblocking of ground military units wanting to enter an international NATO base
-Correction on the nationalities of US governors after the midterms
-Modification of the AI algorithm that calculates the scenario of overthrow of the head of state in countries with parliamentary and presidential regimes (notably the limitation of military putschs in democratic countries)
-Correction of the budget deficit calculation after regional independence
-Correction of growth explosions related to the expiration of energy or water economic contracts
-Renaming of the port of Bremerhaven
-Renaming of the Yamal-Europe pipeline
-Correction of the distribution of religions in Armenia
-Repositioning of the city of Fos de Iguaçu in Brazil
-Correction of a freeze at 23:59 in some long lasting game situations
-Correction of political alignement of governing parties in Canada and Estonia
-Correction of state budgets in Venezuela
-Correction after access to power when playing the opposition
-Update of the road accident rate in Russia
-Correction of some values after annexing countries
-Increase in God'n'Spy of the maximum value of the exceptional electric production
-Update of the budget deficits of Ireland and Australia
-Corrections on the sale of nuclear power plants
-Modification of the calculation of the delivery time when buying military units
-Correction on the automatic renewal of highway construction
-Unblocked internet censorship from the Media panel
-Correction on the request of the last population census
-Correction of a reform including the modification of the income tax
-Adjustment on the discovery by AI countries of the atomic weapon in the future
-Correction on floods on some South American coasts attributed to a wrong country
-Corrections when ending the Covid epidemic
-Addition of the EU subsidy count when building wind or solar power plants
-Correction on the temporal graph of road accidents
-Various corrections 

We would like to thank the entire community and beta testers for their collaboration in improving the game. 

If you encounter any bugs or inaccuracies in the game, or if you have suggestions for improvements, do not hesitate to contact us: on support@power-and-revolution.com (technical problems) or on contact@power-and-revolution.com (other problems or suggestions)

notes.title: macOS version is available
notes.notes:
The macOS version of P&R 2022 Edition has been released today.
DLCs God'N Spy and Modding Tool are also available.

notes.title: Modding Tool DLC and patch 6.82 released
notes.notes:
The Modding Tool DLC for Power & Revolution 2022 Edition is now available.
All information here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1956530/Modding_Tool_Addon__Power__Revolution_2022_Edition/

Additionally, the update 6.82 has just been released.
See below the list of impovements and corrections:

-Ukrainian units update (tank, missile launcher)
-Updated political contexts in Peru (coalition) (composition of parliament) and Nicaragua
-Added multinational bases of the NATO enhanced forward presence in Estonia, Lithuania, Latvia, Poland
-Added the Italian Prime Minister's party to the Italian government coalition
-Updated MEPs for Italy and France
-Updated the % of parties in France according to the April presidential election
-Correction on the possibility to name his ministers when the player changes his political party for a more extreme party
-Correction on the movement of troops to the front in contradiction with the selected military strategy
-Improved realism of growth calculation algorithms related to economic organizations and free trade agreements
-Fixed a sneaky bug in the election results of non-player countries with regional parties after playing and making election promises in a player country
-Updated the energy mix of a number of countries
-Systematically adding your own country to the list of lenders to finance your debt
-Changed the popularity impact following the construction of nuclear fusion power plants
-Corrected some proper names in Portuguese
-Updated some bans on animal welfare in Russia
-Improved conditions for the end of the war between Russia and Ukraine when controlled by the AI
Corrected the right-hand side of the estimated CO2 emissions in line with the targets set after the year change
-Taking into account a fixed bonus/malus when using the God'n'Spy to modify some character variables (protection, morale...)
-Correction on the G7 expansion proposal
-Updated combat drone capacity for some countries
-Unlocking of production after subsidies in some sectors linked to technology discoveries
-Correction on COP balance requests
-Adjustment of the algorithm for calculating illiteracy for all countries in the world
-Various corrections during annexations
-Correction of the seats in the European Parliament when a state enters or leaves the EU
-Improved AI behavior of neighboring countries of warring nations to prevent illogical wars
-Corrected titles during the Africa Cup of Nations soccer tournament 
-Improved missile and anti-missile display
-Added option to automatically restart construction in housing
-Fixed Covid epidemic in some countries
-Added the possibility to make an appointment with your ministers directly from the agenda
-Correction of the automatic repatriation of troops after their initial sending to the front by cargo plane
-Added the right candidates for the French election in the World without Covid scenario
-Correction on missile delivery
-Updated crime rates for a number of countries
-Correction on making appointments with some personalities who relay conspiracy theories
-Modification of the WTO criteria towards more flexibility
-Correction on the disappearance of cities taken by illegal organizations
-Modification of popularity gains following 5G construction
-Various corrections

We would like to thank the entire community and beta testers for their collaboration in improving the game. 

If you encounter any bugs or inaccuracies in the game, or if you have suggestions for improvements, do not hesitate to contact us: on support@power-and-revolution.com (technical problems) or on contact@power-and-revolution.com (other problems or suggestions)

notes.title: Update 6.81 release
notes.notes:
The update 6.81 for Power & Revolution 2022 Edition to be released early next week!

Read below the list of its content:

-Corrections on the localization bases (wind turbines, military bases...)
- Triggering of peace treaties after the end of the conflict with GNS 
-Added possibility to request weapons from AI countries when playing a country at war
-Added the functionality of choosing the foreign political party to approach with the secret services
-Added a new system of delegation and choice of military strategy during a conflict
-Fixed inflation rate lock at 0 when reloading
-Correction of the prison occupancy rate
-Correction of the display of prices in economic contracts with non-dollar currency
-Correction of skin colors in South Africa
-Strengthening the impact of the secret services on the foreign parties approached and financed
-Display of costumes for Shia and Sunni religious leaders
-Modification of the alignments of political parties on the level of tax control
-Initialization of prevention budgets against earthquakes and pollution-related disasters
-Corrections on answers during meetings with heads of state following a request to act against global warming
-Correction on the number of housing units built
-Update of various German data (including composition of parliament and new Berlin airport)
-Fixed double-button in Construction of 4G networks in campaign promise
-Fixed a crash when dispatching military troops
-Correction of the text on enlargement to the G7
-Triggering of the Russia-Ukraine conflict in free mode Opponents
-Adjustment of illiteracy theme for all countries in the world
-Adjustment of global warming theme
-Modification of the investment threshold to open a new sector of activity
-Added new flag of Afghanistan
-Correction of wine consumption data in Argentina
-The Eastern Donbass is no longer considered an enemy of Russia at the end of the war against Ukraine
-Fixed display bugs of some scenario illustration images
-Removed double flash news when launching the "Baden's Challenge" scenario
-Removal of the possibility of making a donation of arms to a country as an election campaign promise
-Fixed a crash when trying to access information about a new organization
-It is now possible to dismantle Hydroelectric and Biomass constructions
-Addition of the new President of the European Parliament
-Troops from East Donbass now assists the Russian army in the war against Ukraine
-Fixed subsidies when applied to multiple sectors at the same time
-Fixed the blocked cargo planes if their destination city was conquered while on the way
-Fixed dimension bug for Rebel armies icons on the world map
-Finalization of translations for specific languages


We would like to thank the entire community and beta testers for their collaboration in improving the game. 

If you encounter any bugs or inaccuracies in the game, or if you have suggestions for improvements, do not hesitate to contact us: on support@power-and-revolution.com (technical problems) or on contact@power-and-revolution.com (other problems or suggestions)
